requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop and implement NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000 pages for Black and 6,000 pages for CMY, with CMY bottle size >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To support high-volume printing and reduce frequency of bottle replacement, enhancing user convenience and competitiveness against rivals.
requirements.Stakeholders: R&D, Product Management, End Users, Operations
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, tank size, IDS integration, ink compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB keyed bottles are validated to deliver at least 6,000 pages (Black, CMY) and CMY bottle size supports >8,000 pages as per ISO standards in field and lab tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new ink bottles are designed for spill-free operation during user refills, leveraging metal foiled labyrinth and lid label technologies.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize mess and improve user satisfaction, reducing support calls and warranty claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, NOA-F integration, manufacturing process
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Refill process achieves <1% spill rate in user testing across 100+ cycles; zero major leakage incidents in warranty period.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (New Output Assembly - Fill) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining current click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and traceability while maintaining user familiarity with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing NOA-F design, click-on push-push, TDF mechanism
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F assembly passes reliability and traceability tests, and is compatible with current push-push and TDF features.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA hardware and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for the Magellan printer series.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D cost, speeds time to market, and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new system architecture, ink delivery system
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks are integrated and pass all functional and reliability tests in Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Reliability, WVTR, Air Gain, Flow Rate, and IDS Characterization
requirements.Description: Perform comprehensive modeling and characterization for reliability, Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and Ink Delivery System (IDS), including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures long-term performance, reliability, and consistent print quality throughout the printer's lifespan.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, ink/tank architecture, NOA-F lifecycle
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All parameters (WVTR, air gain, flow rate) meet specified targets in lab and simulated field environments for startup and EOL scenarios.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in both tank and print system, assessing impact to print quality (PQ) over time.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents print quality degradation and ensures reliable operation over extended use.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink chemistry, tank design, IDS parameters
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability models predict PQ within defined tolerances for 2-year/80k page warranty period.

requirements.Title: Support for Service Parts and Warranty
requirements.Description: NOA-F should be available as a service part for in-warranty support, enabling field replacement as needed.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Parts logistics, NOA-F modularity, documentation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F service parts are stocked and field-replaceable within standard warranty procedures.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cartridges
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 factory line for NOA-F integration; add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool to Orcus 5 line; provision molds for 1-4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing readiness for new components and reduces production bottlenecks.
requirements.Dependencies: Factory layout, tooling, supply chain
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 and Orcus 5 lines are validated for new components with no production delays; molds for new caps are operational.

requirements.Title: Page Yield and Warranty Life Targets
requirements.Description: Support new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages and 2-year warranty, with throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive benchmarks and customer expectations for reliability and value.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware reliability, ink/tank capacity, IDS, service model
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units meet 80,000 page yield and 2-year warranty targets in accelerated life and field tests; throughput verified at specified PPM.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA (Print Head Assembly) and NOA-F to be customer-replaceable, supporting self-serviceability for users.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and printer downtime, improving customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Modular design, user documentation, parts availability
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F with no tools or with simple instructions; >95% success rate in usability tests.

requirements.Title: Product Size Optimization
requirements.Description: Increase tank size (Reddington ID) with no change to Marconi-HI ADF; optimize input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion while minimizing overall footprint.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity while maintaining compact form factor for competitive advantage.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and tray design, mechanical integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Final product dimensions meet tank capacity and fit within defined size envelope; trays function reliably with new tank design.

requirements.Title: Sayan Sibstar Tube Integration and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes for 4-tube platform with new routing and integration to support increased tank size and optimized carriage movement.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable ink delivery and efficient internal layout for new tank configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube sourcing, routing design, carriage compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube integration passes reliability and flow rate tests; carriage operates within specified dynamic and force parameters.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management and spit platform to accommodate changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and ensures long-term reliability as tank and ink system change.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station design, tank configuration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system passes environmental and reliability tests, with no increased contamination over current platform.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamics and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force modeling to account for new tube routing and increased weights from larger tanks.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains print quality and mechanical reliability with new system configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Carriage design, tube integration, tank weight
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage dynamics meet print quality and reliability specs under all operational scenarios.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paperpath design to support increased page life target (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures durability and reliability for higher page count over printer lifespan.
requirements.Dependencies: Paperpath materials, mechanical design, service model
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath passes accelerated wear tests for 80k page life with no major failures.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Service Center)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance system as a serviceable part, to be replaced post-80k page life at service centers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables continued printer operation beyond warranty period and supports service revenue.
requirements.Dependencies: Modular ink maintenance design, service documentation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is replaceable in service center in under 30 minutes; documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: New Make-break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection in IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI (Level of Ink) One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new tank architecture, ensures secure ink delivery, and prevents misinstallation.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, LEBI tank development, SHAID integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS connections pass leak, misinstallation, and reliability tests; SHAID correctly identifies tank and ink level.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management for IDS to ensure reliable operation and prevent air ingress.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains print quality and system reliability, especially with new tank and ink system.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware, firmware update, air management components
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm passes reliability and startup time tests; air management prevents air bubbles in >99% of test cycles.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new algorithms for servicing and startup to optimize performance, reliability, and user experience with new ink/tank system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures seamless user experience and supports new hardware features.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware development, hardware integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New algorithms pass functional and reliability tests, and reduce startup/service time by at least 20%.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Tracking
requirements.Description: Define and implement new print quality goals and depletion tracking to align with new page yield definition and tank capacity.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output and accurate yield reporting for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, IDS, ink/tank design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion tracking meet accuracy targets in >95% of test scenarios; yields reported match ISO standards.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Hi PDL, Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU modules in the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and risk by using proven, reliable components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform architecture
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused modules pass integration and functional validation in Magellan system.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for enhanced connectivity and system performance.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern wireless standards and improves user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware integration, Wi-Fi certification
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module and firmware pass connectivity and performance tests in all supported regions.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security for Hardware and Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware for the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Protects against security threats and meets enterprise requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: HW/FW integration, security certification
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes internal and third-party security audits for Gauss4.xx compliance.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability goals and enables sales in regulated markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for environment, supply chain compliance
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for all target markets.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging to protect the product during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces damage in transit and supports product reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging design, supply chain
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: <0.5% damage rate in shipping tests; packaging passes drop and vibration tests.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models with solutions including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, onboarding paths (Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP), scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and addresses diverse customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Software solutions, onboarding flows, support infrastructure
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All business model features are available and tested for respective customer segments at launch.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Compatibility
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates easy setup and broad compatibility across user environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Driver development, client integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are fully functional and pass compatibility tests with Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Schedule and SuperAmp PHA Life Constraint
requirements.Description: Adhere to project schedule and maintain SuperAmp PHA life at 65,000 pages as a hard constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures timely delivery and reliable component lifespan.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA testing, project management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Project milestones are met; SuperAmp PHA achieves 65,000 page life in reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability - Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a serviceable maintenance box to support easy replacement and reduce service time.
requirements.Rationale: Improves field serviceability and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, service documentation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is field-replaceable in under 15 minutes by service personnel; >95% success rate in field tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Flexibility
requirements.Description: Provide flexibility to host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K yields as a lower-priority, customer-driven feature.
requirements.Rationale: Allows adaptation to specific market or customer requirements as needed.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink/tank capacity, firmware, market feedback
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product can be configured for 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page yields if required by market.
